output_list.reason: The function setupAirDrop is open to all users. The only way to control the status of airDrop is to call this function. If an attacker can call this function, he can control the status of airDrop. The attacker can use this to his advantage, to control the status of airDrop, to control the transfer of tokens to participants of airDrop. A good practice is to make the function owner only.
